title: French Borrowing Costs Hit Highest Level Since 2008 as Budget Crisis Deepens
detail: France's 10-year OAT yield jumped to roughly 4.6–4.7%, its highest since July 2008, while the spread over German Bunds passed 100 basis points for the first time since the 2012 eurozone debt crisis. Investors are demanding a growing risk premium on French debt as the Lecornu government heads into a third consecutive year of budget brinkmanship, with a 2027 draft budget requiring roughly €30 billion in savings threatening to topple the government ahead of the spring presidential election.

media.caption: France's borrowing costs climb to their highest level since 2008.

title: Macron Announces French Troop Deployment to Protect Saudi Red Sea Oil Hub
detail: President Emmanuel Macron announced France will send soldiers, radar systems and air defense assets to help protect Saudi Arabia's Yanbu oil terminal on the Red Sea, a key export route that has come under Houthi missile attacks. Macron said the deployment was meant to 'protect this site' rather than draw France into the conflict, without specifying troop numbers or a deployment timeline.

media.caption: Macron announces French forces will help protect Saudi Arabia's Red Sea oil infrastructure.
